name: Wild Magic installs its periodic aura with the authored values (#2733)
contract: #2733: Wild Magic 705559 is a passive whose effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL (amplitude 4999 ms) triggering 707651 on the Pyromancer; 707651 is an infinite aura with ProcChance 50 whose effect 1 is 50 (bp 49) and effect 2 is 85 (bp 84), the values the Dragon's Wrath hook in AscensionPyromancerAbilities.cpp reads for the extra Magic damage (50 + INT*0.125 percent) and the mana drain (85 + INT*0.4). This file asserts the deterministic half: 707651 is absent before learning, present within 10 s after, and carries the authored values. The 50 percent damage copy 804103 itself is a proc roll and is not asserted, because the group report records no castable Dragon's Wrath setup (cost, cooldown, resource) to drive it repeatedly.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The Wild Magic aura is absent before the passive
The periodic trigger installs the Wild Magic aura
